annotations.title: Generate Stripe Plan Upgrade or Portal Link

description: Generate a live 1-click Stripe Checkout session URL or Stripe Customer Billing Portal link to upgrade a Nuntior workspace subscription. Supports upgrading to `starter` ($19/mo, 12 social connections, 1,500 posts/mo), `builder` ($35/mo, 35 social connections, 10,000 posts/mo), or `scale` ($79/mo, 100 social connections, 50,000 posts/mo + $0.50 per extra connection), plus optional `dedicated_phone` ($1.50/mo E.164 number for SMS, WhatsApp, and SIP Voice AI). Returns `checkoutUrl` (or `portalUrl`), target plan metadata, connection quotas, and user instructions.

action.description: Billing operation: 'checkout' creates a new Stripe Checkout upgrade session URL; 'portal' generates a Stripe Customer Portal link to manage existing payment methods and invoices.

apiKey.description: Optional Nuntior Bearer API key (`ntr_live_...`) override when not provided in the HTTP `Authorization` header.

dedicated_phone.description: When true, attaches a dedicated E.164 telecom phone number add-on ($1.50/mo) for transactional SMS, WhatsApp Business Cloud, and SIP Voice AI agents.

plan.description: Target subscription tier: 'starter' ($19/mo, 12 connections), 'builder' ($35/mo, 35 connections), or 'scale' ($79/mo, 100 connections).

name: billing_upgrade
title: Generate Stripe Plan Upgrade or Portal Link
